name: Novavis
sum: Aptian enantiornithean from the Xiagou Formation of Gansu with an unusually short pubis.
holotype: IVPP V31957, six or seven tail vertebrae, part of the pelvis and most of both hindlimbs on one slab, found in 2005 near Changma.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: O'Connor et al. 2025
